description: Check the status of a previously posted task. Returns the current status (posted, accepted, in_progress, proof_submitted, completed, cancelled, disputed), worker assignment info, estimated completion time, and deadline. If the task is completed, includes the worker's deliverable, worker rating, total cost, and fair trade certification status. Poll this after posting a task to track progress.

task_id.description: The task ID returned from post_task
